Subject: Greenridge kickoff: draft MAP and proposed dates

Hi Aisha / Daniel —

Great speaking earlier. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that aligns milestones with owners and proposed dates. High-level asks for this thread:

- Confirm the proposed technical kickoff (Sep 15) and final go-live window (Nov 7–14).
- Flag any mandatory compliance checkpoints (SOC2 evidence, network scan windows) that must be inserted.
- Confirm procurement contact for SOW/invoice routing.

What I attached: Greenridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners) and a lightweight SOW draft (SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf).

Next step: If you’re good with the dates I’ll loop in our implementation lead (Neha) and CS lead (Marissa) for a 60-min technical kickoff.

Thanks —
Ben

Subject: Re: Greenridge kickoff: draft MAP and proposed dates

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side after reviewing the draft:

- The go-live window is fine, but our compliance team requires a SOC2 evidence review before the technical kickoff is scheduled. Can that be completed by Sep 12? If not, we’ll need to push the kickoff out by one week.
- We also need a dedicated network maintenance window for the integration test on Sep 29 between 02:00–06:00 UTC. Can your infra team accommodate that slot?
- Procurement is procurement@greenridge.com — they’ll need the SOW and a plain-English payment schedule.

Also looping in Daniel (ops) — Daniel, are there any blackout dates in October we should avoid?

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Thomas
VP Product Operations | Greenridge Payments

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 08:38:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Greenridge kickoff: draft MAP and proposed dates

Aisha —

Appreciate the notes. I pulled together an updated MAP section below that addresses the SOC2 checkpoint and the Sep 29 integration test window. Please review and confirm.

Proposed MAP (milestones with owners & dates):

1) SOC2 evidence submission & review — Owner: Greenridge / Point owner: Aisha / Redwood support: Neha — Target complete: 2025-09-11
2) Technical kickoff (60m) — Owner: Redwood (Neha) & Greenridge (Daniel) — Target: 2025-09-16 10:00 PT (tentative; pending SOC2 clearance)
3) Integration test (staging) — Owner: Redwood infra (Marissa) & Greenridge ops — Window: 2025-09-29 02:00–06:00 UTC (as requested)
4) Acceptance UAT run & feedback loop — Owner: Greenridge QA (Daniel) — Window: 2025-10-20 to 2025-10-23
5) Final config & soft-launch — Owner: Redwood Implementation (Neha) — Target: 2025-11-07
6) Go-live (full traffic) — Target window: 2025-11-10 to 2025-11-14

Immediate asks for your team:
- Confirm SOC2 evidence delivery by Sep 11 or call out blockers.
- Confirm Daniel’s availability for the kickoff on Sep 16 or propose an alternate week (Sep 22–26).
- Approve the Sep 29 maintenance/test window.

If those three checkpoints are green I’ll schedule the technical kickoff invite and share a short runbook (30–45m) for the first session.

On process/ownership: we suggest Redwood handles the staging deploy and runbook for the Sep 29 test, Greenridge owns QA sign-off and procurement handles invoice routing. We’ll keep a single MAP spreadsheet updated in Drive.

— Neha Kapoor
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

Quick update from implementation scheduling:

- SOC2 evidence review by Sep 11 — flagged: Greenridge noted they may need extra time. If the evidence arrives after Sep 11, I recommend we still run a shortened kickoff (30m) to align stakeholders and pin dates, then follow with a technical deep-dive once evidence is cleared.
- Sep 29 maintenance window — confirmed. Our infra team will open a maintenance ticket and allocate an on-call engineer for the test window.
- Draft SOW: I updated the payment schedule section to 30/60/10 split as a suggested option (attached as SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf). Please confirm if procurement needs a different milestone-based invoice layout.

Proposed kickoff times (all PT):
- Option A: 2025-09-16 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: 2025-09-18 09:00–10:00 PT

If we don’t hear back by Sep 17 EOD PT I’ll book Option A tentatively.

Thanks —

Team —

Thanks, all. Quick confirmations:

- SOC2 evidence: We’ll deliver evidence artifacts by COB Sep 11 as requested.
- Kickoff: Sep 16 10:00 PT works for Daniel and me — please send the invite.
- Maintenance window: Sep 29 confirmed.
- Procurement: procurement@greenridge.com acknowledges the SOW; they prefer the milestone-based invoice layout (please include a plain-language payment schedule).

A couple of asks before kickoff:
1) Can Redwood provide a 1-page runbook for the Sep 29 test (roles, rollback criteria, contact list)?
2) Please include estimated token-cost guidance for the integration (ballpark monthly) so our finance team has a heads up.

Once I have the invite I’ll loop in one more security reviewer (cc’d later).

Appreciate it — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Aisha
VP Product Operations | Greenridge Payments
